environment.description: ECS Fargate task in isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumer access requires VPC endpoint interface in their VPC with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/PricingConsumerRole. Security group on the ENI allows inbound TCP 3000 only from CIDR 10.0.48.0/24 (consumer subnet). Port 3001 (TCP transport) has no listener on the NLB. Task IAM role has no network-related permissions. VPC flow logs enabled with rejection logging to CloudWatch.

network.subnet_type: isolated (no route to IGW or NAT)

config.authentication: VPC endpoint policy + IAM principal restriction
config.validation: Consumer service (API Gateway with request schema validation) is the only authorized caller
